column1: # Power check limits (C-114). tools/power/check.sh compares each run (the median of several) with "limit"; "-" = report only.
# Set from 3 runs of v1.2-dev 7a4270f (C-113 merged), 2026-11-13: limit = (max over the runs) * mult + add, rounded up (s to 0.01, kb and frames/turn to 0.1).
# Tighten from new runs: bash tools/power/check.sh --runs 3 --write-limits (only lowers; --loosen also raises).
